Health issues are split between prevention and treatment. Your Care Team keeps small problems from interrupting the career too often.
The Health Clinic is for active conditions: illness, burnout, injuries, sleep trouble, chronic pain, or serious screening follow-up.
A strong save usually uses both. Staff reduce friction week to week, while clinic visits clear the issues already affecting health, work, or recovery.
Care Team can quietly handle minor cold, flu, workload headache, or back-pain moments and show it in the live feed.
Health Clinic still matters when a condition is active, severe, chronic, public, or needs proper treatment choices.
Ignoring a small issue can let it worsen, so prevention saves money and attention without replacing real treatment.
Why both exist
Care Team is the safety net you pay weekly for; Health Clinic is the deliberate action you take when the body actually needs care.

Health, Care Team & Clinic
Health issues are split between prevention and treatment. Your Care Team keeps small problems from interrupting the career too often.
The Health Clinic is for active conditions: illness, burnout, injuries, sleep trouble, chronic pain, or serious screening follow-up.
A strong save usually uses both. Staff reduce friction week to week, while clinic visits clear the issues already affecting health, work, or recovery.
Care Team can quietly handle minor cold, flu, workload headache, or back-pain moments and show it in the live feed.
Health Clinic still matters when a condition is active, severe, chronic, public, or needs proper treatment choices.
Ignoring a small issue can let it worsen, so prevention saves money and attention without replacing real treatment.
Why both exist
Care Team is the safety net you pay weekly for; Health Clinic is the deliberate action you take when the body actually needs care.

Quick answers to common player questions without spoiling hidden formulas.
Why am I not getting bigger roles?
Bigger roles come from the full picture, not one stat. Improve talent, reputation, preparation, experience, and representation together.
What is the difference between fame, followers, and reputation?
Fame is how known you are. Followers are your social audience. Reputation is how trusted and respected you are professionally.
Why is my business not making much money?
Check the whole setup. Weak pricing, low hype, poor quality, low stock, limited staff, or low expansion can all hold a business back.
Why does marketing not always explode sales?
Marketing boosts demand, but it cannot replace fundamentals like stock, staffing, pricing, and positioning.
How do I manage energy better?
Plan around one or two outcomes that matter most right now. Rest and focus often beat chaotic activity.
Why do I need Care Team and Health Clinic?
Care Team is weekly prevention and light handling for small issues. Health Clinic is direct treatment for active conditions and serious problems.
Why did I lose a sponsorship or take a fine?
Active contracts still need follow-through. Check the Team app and complete required actions on time.
Why did my relationship get worse?
Relationships need attention over time. Long neglect creates strain, especially during career or business pressure.
How does the production house really work?
Your studio performs best when the pipeline is healthy: development, production, release timing, and catalog building.
Why did my script quality change?
Script quality is shaped by development choices, creative identity, genre fit, story direction, and package coherence.
What is the difference between format, genre, and tone?
Format is the package, genre is the audience promise, and tone is how the story feels moment to moment.
When should I link a character?
Link a character when the role is meant to be the same identity across sequels, crossovers, events, recasts, or franchise parts.
Why do sequels care about old cast?
Returning cast helps continuity and audience recognition, but they still need to be brought into the new production properly.
Why did my movie leave theaters or move on?
Releases move through stages. Theatrical runs end, and outcomes can push a title toward the next release phase.
How should I think about loans?
Loans help when they unlock a clear move, but monthly payment pressure continues until the balance is handled.
How do I keep a save strong for the long term?
Build more than one pillar. Career, money, relationships, and long-term choices create stronger late-game saves.

Health, Care Team & Clinic
Health issues are split between prevention and treatment. Your Care Team keeps small problems from interrupting the career too often.
The Health Clinic is for active conditions: illness, burnout, injuries, sleep trouble, chronic pain, or serious screening follow-up.
A strong save usually uses both. Staff reduce friction week to week, while clinic visits clear the issues already affecting health, work, or recovery.
Care Team can quietly handle minor cold, flu, workload headache, or back-pain moments and show it in the live feed.
Health Clinic still matters when a condition is active, severe, chronic, public, or needs proper treatment choices.
Ignoring a small issue can let it worsen, so prevention saves money and attention without replacing real treatment.
Why both exist
Care Team is the safety net you pay weekly for; Health Clinic is the deliberate action you take when the body actually needs care.

Quick answers to common player questions without spoiling hidden formulas.
Why am I not getting bigger roles?
Bigger roles come from the full picture, not one stat. Improve talent, reputation, preparation, experience, and representation together.
What is the difference between fame, followers, and reputation?
Fame is how known you are. Followers are your social audience. Reputation is how trusted and respected you are professionally.
Why is my business not making much money?
Check the whole setup. Weak pricing, low hype, poor quality, low stock, limited staff, or low expansion can all hold a business back.
Why does marketing not always explode sales?
Marketing boosts demand, but it cannot replace fundamentals like stock, staffing, pricing, and positioning.
How do I manage energy better?
Plan around one or two outcomes that matter most right now. Rest and focus often beat chaotic activity.
Why do I need Care Team and Health Clinic?
Care Team is weekly prevention and light handling for small issues. Health Clinic is direct treatment for active conditions and serious problems.
Why did I lose a sponsorship or take a fine?
Active contracts still need follow-through. Check the Team app and complete required actions on time.
Why did my relationship get worse?
Relationships need attention over time. Long neglect creates strain, especially during career or business pressure.
How does the production house really work?
Your studio performs best when the pipeline is healthy: development, production, release timing, and catalog building.
Why did my script quality change?
Script quality is shaped by development choices, creative identity, genre fit, story direction, and package coherence.
What is the difference between format, genre, and tone?
Format is the package, genre is the audience promise, and tone is how the story feels moment to moment.
When should I link a character?
Link a character when the role is meant to be the same identity across sequels, crossovers, events, recasts, or franchise parts.
Why do sequels care about old cast?
Returning cast helps continuity and audience recognition, but they still need to be brought into the new production properly.
Why did my movie leave theaters or move on?
Releases move through stages. Theatrical runs end, and outcomes can push a title toward the next release phase.
How should I think about loans?
Loans help when they unlock a clear move, but monthly payment pressure continues until the balance is handled.
How do I keep a save strong for the long term?
Build more than one pillar. Career, money, relationships, and long-term choices create stronger late-game saves.

Welcome to Actor Empire
You are building a life, not just chasing one role. The best saves balance career, money, fame, relationships, studio power, and long-term planning.
Each week is a resource puzzle. Spend energy on acting, social growth, business, or personal life, then age up to see the results.
Build the Career First
CastLink, rehearsals, better agents, and strong performances open the entertainment ladder. Early on, steady work and smart role choices matter more than chasing only giant projects.
Know What Each Stat Does
Fame raises your profile. Reputation improves trust. Followers improve reach. Money gives you options. None of them fully replaces the others.
Businesses do not print money by themselves. Pricing, hype, staffing, stock, and expansion all matter.
Production House is a Long Game
Your studio shines when you develop strong projects, manage releases, and turn wins into a library. Big payoffs can take time.
Connected Stories Need Care
Franchises and universes are powerful because characters, cast, sequels, crossovers, and market memory carry forward.
A plain-language reference for how the game works, what each system is for, and when to care about it.
Your first goal is reliable momentum. Small wins in auditions, social activity, and money management usually beat risky all-in plays at the start.
Think week to week. Every decision competes for time and energy, and spreading too thin slows progress everywhere.
Use the phone apps often. CastLink grows your career, Team handles contracts, social apps build reach, and Guide explains the rest.
Fame is your public profile. It helps you get seen, land bigger opportunities, and stay culturally relevant.
Reputation is how seriously the industry takes you. High reputation supports trust and better long-term outcomes.
Followers are your social reach. They help influence, sponsorships, and online growth, but they cannot carry an acting career alone.
Mood and energy shape how much you can do. A rich account means less if your character is exhausted or unhappy.
CastLink is the main place to find work. Better talent, preparation, experience, and representation improve the quality of roles you can compete for.
Preparation matters. Rehearsals and smart role selection make performances more consistent.
Early game builds a record, mid game builds momentum, and late game is about leverage, choice, and legacy.
Energy is weekly fuel. Acting, social moves, business work, and personal actions all draw from it.
Do not waste empty weeks. If you are waiting on a project, build fame, relationships, skills, or business progress.
Recovery has value. Sometimes restoring your character makes the next few weeks stronger.
Health, Care Team & Clinic
Health issues are split between prevention and treatment. Your Care Team keeps small problems from interrupting the career too often.
The Health Clinic is for active conditions: illness, burnout, injuries, sleep trouble, chronic pain, or serious screening follow-up.
A strong save usually uses both. Staff reduce friction week to week, while clinic visits clear the issues already affecting health, work, or recovery.
Care Team can quietly handle minor cold, flu, workload headache, or back-pain moments and show it in the live feed.
Health Clinic still matters when a condition is active, severe, chronic, public, or needs proper treatment choices.
Ignoring a small issue can let it worsen, so prevention saves money and attention without replacing real treatment.
Why both exist
Care Team is the safety net you pay weekly for; Health Clinic is the deliberate action you take when the body actually needs care.
Social media keeps you visible and can support your broader entertainment career.
Different platforms do different jobs: image, reach, conversation, and monetization.
Use social with purpose. Not every post needs to chase virality.
Professional relationships can change the quality of opportunities you see.
Personal relationships are not just flavor. Neglect can create drama, while healthy bonds support a stronger life path.
Networking works best over time. Repeated effort usually beats one expensive gesture.
Businesses are long-term income engines. Some are steady service businesses, while product businesses reward hands-on management.
Pricing, quality, hype, staffing, stock, and expansion all matter.
Marketing works best when product, capacity, and setup are already healthy.
Think in stages: development, production, release, and afterlife all matter.
Not every project should be rushed. Stronger planning can beat forcing everything out quickly.
Your library matters. Over time, the studio becomes more valuable when you build a catalog instead of relying on one hit.

Quick answers to common player questions without spoiling hidden formulas.
Why am I not getting bigger roles?
Bigger roles come from the full picture, not one stat. Improve talent, reputation, preparation, experience, and representation together.
What is the difference between fame, followers, and reputation?
Fame is how known you are. Followers are your social audience. Reputation is how trusted and respected you are professionally.
Why is my business not making much money?
Check the whole setup. Weak pricing, low hype, poor quality, low stock, limited staff, or low expansion can all hold a business back.
Why does marketing not always explode sales?
Marketing boosts demand, but it cannot replace fundamentals like stock, staffing, pricing, and positioning.
How do I manage energy better?
Plan around one or two outcomes that matter most right now. Rest and focus often beat chaotic activity.
Why do I need Care Team and Health Clinic?
Care Team is weekly prevention and light handling for small issues. Health Clinic is direct treatment for active conditions and serious problems.
Why did I lose a sponsorship or take a fine?
Active contracts still need follow-through. Check the Team app and complete required actions on time.
Why did my relationship get worse?
Relationships need attention over time. Long neglect creates strain, especially during career or business pressure.
How does the production house really work?
Your studio performs best when the pipeline is healthy: development, production, release timing, and catalog building.
Why did my script quality change?
Script quality is shaped by development choices, creative identity, genre fit, story direction, and package coherence.
What is the difference between format, genre, and tone?
Format is the package, genre is the audience promise, and tone is how the story feels moment to moment.
When should I link a character?
Link a character when the role is meant to be the same identity across sequels, crossovers, events, recasts, or franchise parts.
Why do sequels care about old cast?
Returning cast helps continuity and audience recognition, but they still need to be brought into the new production properly.
Why did my movie leave theaters or move on?
Releases move through stages. Theatrical runs end, and outcomes can push a title toward the next release phase.
How should I think about loans?
Loans help when they unlock a clear move, but monthly payment pressure continues until the balance is handled.
How do I keep a save strong for the long term?
Build more than one pillar. Career, money, relationships, and long-term choices create stronger late-game saves.
